mapper.sql: ) s LEFT JOIN translation t ON t.source_hash = SHA2(s.source_text, 256) WHERE s.source_text IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(s.source_text) > 0 AND t.id IS NULL ORDER BY s.source_text LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT p.title COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS source_text FROM performance p UNION ALL SELECT o.override_value COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin FROM performance_override o WHERE o.field_name = 'title'
SELECT v.name COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS source_text FROM venue v
SELECT st.name_ko COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS source_text FROM station st WHERE st.name_ja IS NULL OR TRIM(st.name_ja) = ''

SELECT p.cast_text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS source_text FROM performance p UNION ALL SELECT p.ticket_price COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin FROM performance p UNION ALL SELECT p.schedule_text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin FROM performance p UNION ALL SELECT p.runtime COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin FROM performance p UNION ALL SELECT p.age_limit COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin FROM performance p UNION ALL SELECT o.override_value COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin FROM performance_override o WHERE o.field_name IN ('cast_text', 'ticket_price', 'schedule_text', 'runtime', 'age_limit') UNION ALL SELECT b.name COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin FROM booking_site b UNION ALL SELECT v.address COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin FROM venue v UNION ALL SELECT c.location_text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin FROM coin_locker c
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO translation (source_hash, source_text, translated_text, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{r.sourceHash}, #{r.sourceText}, #{r.translatedText}, #{r.createdAt}, #{r.createdAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
